$doc: out/factory/questions.json — the questions for the factory, generated by tools/gen_questions.py. Every {token} in tools/data/factory_questions.json was filled from the file named in `facts`.

doc.title: Questions for the factory
doc.sub: The things only a factory with real machines, real materials and real measurement can answer. Each question says why we ask and what we will do with each possible answer — a question whose answer changes nothing is not on this list.
doc.sub_zh: 只有拥有实机、实料与实测能力的工厂才能回答的问题。每个问题都说明为何提问，以及对每种可能的答复我方将如何处理——答复不会改变任何事情的问题，不在此列。

how_to_answer.en: Answer in the right-hand column of this table, or in any form you like as long as each answer carries our question id (Q1.1 …). Where the answer is a number, we want the number and where it came from: a datasheet page, a coupon you printed and measured, a quotation. 'Typical' is not an answer we can compute with. If a question does not apply to your plant, write 'not applicable' and why — that is a useful answer and we will strike the question.
how_to_answer.zh: 请在本表右栏作答，或采用任何形式作答，只需注明我方问题编号（Q1.1 …）。若答复是数字，请同时给出出处：数据表页码、贵厂打印并实测的试件、或正式报价。“典型值”无法用于计算。若某问题不适用于贵厂，请写“不适用”并说明原因——这同样是有用的答复，我方会据此删除该问题。

sections.title_en: Process capability — what tolerance can you actually hold
sections.title_zh: 工艺能力——贵厂实际能保证的公差
sections.lede_en: Our drawings carry NO in-house tolerance basis. Measured 2026-09-02 and unchanged since: every printer on our farm records tolerance_mm: null with the reason 'no coupon printed and measured on this machine', and Bambu Lab's own spec sheet has no dimensional-accuracy line. Our sheets therefore say DIMENSIONS ARE NOMINAL AS MODELLED and quote an outsourced figure (JLC3DP +/-0.3 mm FDM (jlc3dp.com, ce-machines/farm-jlc3dp); Hubs +/-0.5%, floor +/-0.5 mm (hubs.com/3d-printing/, ce-machines/farm-hubs)) as the only cited number in the repository. Your process capability replaces that note.
sections.lede_zh: 我方图纸没有自有公差依据。2026-09-02 实测且至今未变：我方所有打印机的 tolerance_mm 均为 null，理由是“本机未打印并测量过试件”；Bambu Lab 官方规格书也无尺寸精度条目。因此我方图纸标注“尺寸为建模名义值”，并引用外协数据（JLC3DP +/-0.3 mm FDM (jlc3dp.com, ce-machines/farm-jlc3dp); Hubs +/-0.5%, floor +/-0.5 mm (hubs.com/3d-printing/, ce-machines/farm-hubs)）作为仓库中唯一有出处的数字。贵厂的工艺能力将取代该说明。

questions.ask_en: For FDM in the material you would use, what dimensional tolerance do you hold on (a) an external dimension of 20-100 mm, (b) a hole diameter of 2-22 mm, (c) a wall of 0.8-3 mm? Please answer from a coupon you print and measure, not from a brochure.
questions.ask_zh: 对贵厂拟用材料的 FDM 工艺，(a) 20-100 mm 外形尺寸、(b) Ø2-22 mm 孔径、(c) 0.8-3 mm 壁厚，各能保证多少尺寸公差？请以贵厂实际打印并测量的试件为依据，而非样本手册。
questions.ours_en: In-house: CANNOT DETERMINE. Outsourced, cited: JLC3DP +/-0.3 mm FDM (jlc3dp.com, ce-machines/farm-jlc3dp); Hubs +/-0.5%, floor +/-0.5 mm (hubs.com/3d-printing/, ce-machines/farm-hubs). A planning constant of ±0.2 mm exists in our code and is deliberately NOT used on any sheet because it has no vendor citation.
questions.ours_zh: 自有产线：无法判定。外协并有出处的数据：JLC3DP +/-0.3 mm FDM (jlc3dp.com, ce-machines/farm-jlc3dp); Hubs +/-0.5%, floor +/-0.5 mm (hubs.com/3d-printing/, ce-machines/farm-hubs)。我方代码中有 ±0.2 mm 的规划常数，因无供应商出处，图纸上一律不使用。
questions.source: out/drawings/microduck-shin/result.json — the sheet's own TOLERANCE BASIS notes
branches_en: you hold ±0.2 mm or better on all three
we put your figure on every sheet as the tolerance basis, and the 22×16×4 and 15×10×3 bearing seats can be printed to size without reaming
you hold ±0.3 to ±0.5 mm
we add a reaming or post-machining operation to every bearing and press-fit bore and put it in the routing, and we re-check every clearance in the tolerance stack against your figure
you cannot state a figure without a paid coupon run
we pay for the coupon run — tell us the cost; a measured number is worth more to us than any other single answer on this page
branches_zh: 三项均可保证 ±0.2 mm 或更优
我方将贵厂数据作为公差依据标注于每张图纸；22×16×4 与 15×10×3 轴承座可直接打印到位，无需铰孔
可保证 ±0.3 至 ±0.5 mm
我方为所有轴承孔与压配孔增加铰孔或后加工工序并写入工艺路线，并按贵厂数据重算全部配合尺寸链
未做付费试件则无法给出数值
该试件费用由我方承担，请报价；一个实测数字对我方的价值高于本页任何其他答复

questions.ask_en: How do you prepare a printed bearing seat: print to size, ream, or press with a heated tool? What interference do you hold for a Ø22 h7-class ball bearing into a printed bore, and what pull-out force does it give you?
questions.ask_zh: 打印件轴承座如何处理：直接打印到位、铰孔、还是加热压装？Ø22 级滚珠轴承压入打印孔时贵厂控制多少过盈量，可获得多大拔出力？
questions.ours_en: NO interference is specified anywhere in our repository. The seats are modelled at nominal (Ø16.000 boss, Ø22.000 bore) and no ISO 286 fit class is declared on any bore, because FDM cannot be sized to one (H7/p6 at Ø22 is a 0.021 mm band). There are 11 bearings of 22×16×4 and 3 of 15×10×3 in the robot.
questions.ours_zh: 我方仓库中未规定任何过盈量。轴承座按名义尺寸建模（Ø16.000 轴肩、Ø22.000 孔），且任何孔位均未标注 ISO 286 配合等级，因为 FDM 无法达到该精度（Ø22 的 H7/p6 公差带仅 0.021 mm）。整机有 22×16×4 轴承 11 个、15×10×3 轴承 3 个。
questions.source: tools/data/playbook.json open['Interference at every printed bearing seat'] = CANNOT DETERMINE; SPEC.md:77-78
branches_en: you press into a printed bore with a stated interference
we model the bore at your nominal minus that interference and put the press force on the station sheet
you ream every seat
we add the reamed size and the ream allowance to the drawing and to the routing, and the seat becomes a controlled dimension
you would rather we design in a heat-set steel sleeve
we will — tell us the sleeve you stock and we re-model the seat around it
branches_zh: 按规定过盈量直接压入打印孔
我方按贵厂名义尺寸减去该过盈量建模，并将压装力写入工位卡
每个座孔均铰孔
我方在图纸与工艺路线中标注铰后尺寸与铰削余量，该孔成为受控尺寸
建议改用热压钢衬套
可以，请告知贵厂常备衬套规格，我方据此重做座孔

questions.ask_en: What is your minimum printable wall, minimum hole, and minimum unsupported bridge on the process you would use for these parts? We are asking you rather than telling you, because OUR OWN SHEETS CANNOT ANSWER THIS and we would rather say so than hand you a number that does not mean what it looks like.
questions.ask_zh: 针对本项目零件，贵厂工艺的最小可打印壁厚、最小孔径与最大无支撑跨桥各为多少？此处是向贵方提问而非告知，因为我方图纸本身回答不了这个问题；与其给贵方一个看似有意义、实则并非如此的数字，不如如实说明。
questions.ours_en: Our print profile is 2 wall loops at a 0.2 mm layer at a 0.4 mm nozzle, which is the 0.80 mm wall floor every DFM verdict in the playbook is measured against. 12 of 30 parts carry a slicer support warning at that profile. What our sheets DO NOT give you is a comparable wall. On out/drawings/microduck-shin the thinnest-wall figure is 0.0280 mm and the sheet prints it as “THINNEST WALL: 0.03 mm (floor 0.80 mm = 2 perimeters @ 0.4 mm nozzle)” — our own note pairs it with the floor because they are not the same quantity. That figure is a RAY MINIMUM over the solid, taken at a fillet run-out; it is not a wall any process can make or fail to make, so comparing it to your floor would be meaningless. The comparable number on the same sheet is the thinnest measured STEP, 1.0450 mm, which is above our own floor. Producing a real minimum PRINTABLE wall per part is parcel C-4 in WORK-BREAKDOWN.html and it needs your process data.
questions.ours_zh: 我方打印配置为 2 wall loops at a 0.2 mm layer，0.4 mm 喷嘴，对应 0.80 mm 壁厚下限，制造手册中所有 DFM 判定均以此为准。该配置下 30 个零件中有 12 个存在切片支撑警告。但我方图纸给不出可与之比较的壁厚。在 out/drawings/microduck-shin 上，最小壁厚值为 0.0280 mm，图纸原文为“THINNEST WALL: 0.03 mm (floor 0.80 mm = 2 perimeters @ 0.4 mm nozzle)”——我方注释之所以把它与下限并列，正因为二者不是同一个量。该数值是对实体做射线扫描得到的最小值，取自圆角收尾处，并不是任何工艺能做出或做不出的“壁”，因此拿它与贵厂下限比较毫无意义。同一张图纸上可比的数值是最小实测台阶厚度 1.0450 mm，该值高于我方自身下限。为每个零件给出真正的最小可打印壁厚，是 WORK-BREAKDOWN.html 中的工作包 C-4，且需要贵厂工艺数据。
questions.source: tools/data/playbook.json profile (BambuStudio 0.20mm Standard @BBL H2S, inherit chain resolved); out/print/slice.json slicer_warning; out/drawings/microduck-shin/result.json thinnest_wall_mm / thinnest_wall_step_mm / dfm
branches_en: your floors are at or below ours
nothing changes; we keep the geometry, and C-4 records your floor as the basis on every sheet
your floors are above ours

run C-4: give us a minimum printable wall per part on YOUR process, name the parts our geometry goes below it, and we thicken those features and re-run the FEA at the new section. Do not use our sheet's ray minimum to pick the parts — it will name the wrong ones.
you would use a different nozzle or layer height
send the profile; we re-slice every part on it so the grams and hours in the pack are yours, not ours
you want us to state a printable wall ourselves first
we cannot honestly, and that is the whole point of this question: our measurement is a ray minimum and we will not present it as a printable wall
branches_zh: 贵厂下限不高于我方
几何保持不变；C-4 将把贵厂下限作为依据写入每张图纸
贵厂下限高于我方
执行 C-4：按贵厂工艺给出每个零件的最小可打印壁厚，指出我方几何低于该值的零件，我方据此加厚相应特征并按新截面重跑有限元。请勿用我方图纸上的射线最小值来挑选零件——那会挑错。
贵厂拟用不同喷嘴或层高
请提供配置文件，我方按其重新切片全部零件，使交付包中的克数与工时来自贵厂而非我方
希望我方先自行给出可打印壁厚
我方无法诚实地给出，这正是本问题存在的原因：我方的测量值是射线最小值，我方不会把它当作可打印壁厚呈报

questions.ask_en: For the visible shells, what surface finish do you achieve as printed, and what post-process (sanding, vapour, coating, paint) do you recommend at what added cost and cycle time per unit?
questions.ask_zh: 对外观外壳，贵厂打印后可达到何种表面质量？建议何种后处理（打磨、熏蒸、涂层、喷漆）？每台增加的成本与工时各为多少？
questions.ours_en: We have written NO cosmetic acceptance standard — it is an open item in our own playbook. The visible parts are the two trunk shells, the top and bottom head shells and the face part, 95.39 g and 3.37 h of printing per robot between them.
questions.ours_zh: 我方尚未制定外观验收标准——这是我方制造手册中的未决项。外观件为两片躯干壳、上下头壳与面板，每台合计打印 95.39 克、3.37 小时。
questions.source: tools/data/playbook.json open['Cosmetic acceptance standard for a printed shell'] = CANNOT DETERMINE; out/print/slice.json
branches_en: as-printed is acceptable at your line rate
we write your as-printed finish into the cosmetic standard and photograph a golden sample
you recommend a post-process
we cost it per unit against the moulding break-even in section 3 and decide with you
you consider these parts unsuitable for FDM cosmetically
that is the strongest argument for tooling them and it goes straight into section 3
branches_zh: 按贵厂节拍，打印原态即可接受
我方将贵厂原态表面写入外观标准，并拍摄标准样件
贵厂建议做后处理
我方按单台成本与第 3 节的开模盈亏平衡点对比，与贵方共同决策
贵方认为这些外观件不适合 FDM
这将是开模最有力的理由，直接进入第 3 节

questions.ask_en: Do you install M2 brass heat-set inserts in printed parts, with what tool, at what temperature and insertion depth, and what pull-out and torque-to-fail do you get in the material you would use?
questions.ask_zh: 贵厂是否在打印件中安装 M2 黄铜热熔螺母？使用何种工具、温度与压入深度？在拟用材料中可获得多大拔出力与破坏扭矩？
questions.ours_en: The robot is an M2 system. FOUR DIFFERENT FASTENER COUNTS exist in our files and they count different things, so read FACTORY-PACK.html section 3.3a before ordering: 145 HOLE FEATURES in the community census (Ø2.2 clearance ×77, Ø4.4 c'bore ×28, Ø1.6 tap ×20, Ø2.7/2.8 ×20 — a counterbored clearance hole appears TWICE there, so it is an upper bound on holes and not a screw count); 64 screws actually placed in our assembly through a connection; and 325 PIECES on the buy list per robot, which is the one to order against because it includes nuts, five screw lengths and 60 heat-set inserts — as an upper bound with spares, since its basis is our own hole-fitting on Pollen's meshes and it has never been checked against hardware. We have NO torque figure for any of them — ROBOTIS publishes no tightening torque for the XL330's own tapped holes and we refuse to copy a steel-into-steel chart figure into a plastic joint.
questions.ours_zh: 整机为 M2 体系。我方文件中存在四个互不相同的紧固件计数，统计对象各异，下单前请先阅读 FACTORY-PACK.html 3.3a 节：社区统计的孔特征共 145 个（Ø2.2 间隙孔 x77、Ø4.4 沉孔 x28、Ø1.6 攻丝底孔 x20、Ø2.7/2.8 孔 x20——带沉孔的过孔在该表中出现两次，因此它是孔数的上限，不是螺钉数）；我方装配体中经连接件实际装入的螺钉 64 颗；采购清单上每台 325 件，下单应以此为准，因为它包含螺母、五种螺钉长度与 60 个热熔螺母——且应视为含余量的上限，因其依据是我方在 Pollen 网格上的孔位拟合，从未与实物核对。但我方没有任何扭矩数据——ROBOTIS 未公布 XL330 自带螺纹孔的拧紧扭矩，我方拒绝把钢对钢的表格数值套用于塑料连接。
questions.source: SPEC.md:75-76 hole census; spec/sourcing.json B18a/B18b/B18c; out/fasteners/placed.json; out/factory/reconcile.json fasteners; tools/data/playbook.json torque = 3/3 CANNOT DETERMINE
branches_en: you can run a strip test and a pull-out test on our parts
you set the torque schedule and we publish it with your test as the source — this closes the single largest hole in the assembly document
you have house values for M2 into PLA/PETG
send them with the test method and we adopt them provisionally, marked as your figures
you do not use inserts
tell us what you use instead (self-tapping into a boss, nut trap) and we re-model every boss for it
branches_zh: 贵厂可对我方零件做滑牙与拔出试验
由贵厂确定扭矩表，我方以贵厂试验为出处发布——这将补上装配文件中最大的缺口
贵厂有 M2 在 PLA/PETG 中的内部数据
请连同试验方法提供，我方暂按贵厂数据采用并注明来源
贵厂不使用热熔螺母
请告知替代方案（自攻入柱、嵌入螺母槽），我方据此重做所有螺柱

sections.title_en: Materials — our entire structural safety-factor set rests on one assumed number
sections.title_zh: 材料——我方全部结构安全系数都建立在一个假设数值上
sections.lede_en: Every finite-element verdict we publish uses a yield of 50 MPa for PLA, with density 1.24 g/cm³ and modulus {pla_E} GPa, taken from a table in our own CAD library at ce-cad/cecad/fits.py:302. That table row has NO source: our materials module says in its own comments that density and Young's modulus 'exist only in fits.py' and 'have NO SOURCE AT ALL'. It is also isotropic, and FDM is not. So the honest state is that our safety factors are arithmetic on an assumption. Your filament's datasheet replaces it.
sections.lede_zh: 我方发布的每一项有限元判定，PLA 均按屈服 50 MPa、密度 1.24 g/cm³、模量 {pla_E} GPa 计算，取自我方 CAD 库中的一张表（ce-cad/cecad/fits.py:302）。该表行没有任何出处：我方材料模块的注释明确写道，密度与杨氏模量“只存在于 fits.py 中”“完全没有来源”。且该模型为各向同性，而 FDM 并非如此。因此实情是：我方安全系数只是基于假设的算术。贵厂材料数据表将取代它。

questions.ask_en: For each filament you would use, send the datasheet: tensile strength IN-PLANE (XY) and ACROSS LAYERS (Z), Young's modulus, elongation at break, density, and the print settings those coupons were made at. If you have your own coupon data rather than the maker's, we prefer yours.
questions.ask_zh: 请提供贵厂拟用每种耗材的数据表：面内（XY）与层间（Z）拉伸强度、杨氏模量、断裂伸长率、密度，以及试件的打印参数。若贵厂有自测数据而非厂家数据，我方更希望采用贵厂数据。
questions.ours_en: PLA 50 MPa / 1.24 g/cm³ / {pla_E} GPa, isotropic, unsourced (ce-cad/cecad/fits.py:302). Every safety factor in STRUCTURAL.html and SIMULATION.html is computed against that one number.
questions.ours_zh: PLA：50 MPa / 1.24 g/cm³ / {pla_E} GPa，各向同性，无出处（ce-cad/cecad/fits.py:302）。STRUCTURAL.html 与 SIMULATION.html 中每一个安全系数都基于这一个数字。
questions.source: ce-cad/cecad/fits.py:302 and cecad/materials.py comment block on ungrounded properties
branches_en: your XY strength is at or above ours
we re-run every FEA case with your number and republish the safety-factor table with your datasheet as the citation
your Z strength is materially lower (the usual case)

we re-run each part in the orientation you would print it, treating the load across layers, and any part that then fails is re-oriented or re-designed before tooling — this is the correct way to do it and we cannot do it without your Z number
you would use a different polymer entirely
send its datasheet; the material sweep is already automated, so a new material is a re-run, not a redesign
branches_zh: 贵厂 XY 强度不低于我方假设
我方按贵厂数据重跑全部有限元工况，并以贵厂数据表为出处重新发布安全系数表
贵厂 Z 向强度明显更低（常见情形）
我方按贵厂实际打印方向重跑每个零件，按层间受载计算；届时不合格的零件在开模前重新定向或重新设计——这才是正确做法，而没有贵厂 Z 向数据就无法进行
贵厂拟用完全不同的聚合物
请提供其数据表；材料扫掠已自动化，换材料只是重跑，不是重新设计

questions.ask_en: Our simulated landing case FAILS on the ankle in every material we tried: safety factor 0.6737 in PLA at a 60 N single-leg landing, best of the sweep NYLON at 0.9711, all below 1. Would you (a) print the ankle in a stronger material, (b) re-orient it, (c) tell us the load case is unrealistic, or (d) something else?
questions.ask_zh: 我方仿真的落地工况下，踝关节在所有试算材料中均不合格：60 N 单腿落地时 PLA 安全系数 0.6737，扫掠中最好的 NYLON 也仅 0.9711，均小于 1。贵方倾向于：(a) 用更强材料打印踝件、(b) 改变打印方向、(c) 认为该工况不合理、还是 (d) 其他方案？
questions.ours_en: The load case is our own construction: 737 g robot -> 7.23 N weight; 3.6 N/leg standing; ~9.4 N slow-walk single-stance peak. standing=20 N (2x margin), landing=60 N (3x bodyweight one leg), lateral=15 N. Static first-order. It is simulation, it is linear-elastic and isotropic, and no physical ankle has ever been loaded. The standing case passes at 2.0210.
questions.ours_zh: 该工况由我方设定：737 g robot -> 7.23 N weight; 3.6 N/leg standing; ~9.4 N slow-walk single-stance peak. standing=20 N (2x margin), landing=60 N (3x bodyweight one leg), lateral=15 N. Static first-order。这是仿真结果，采用线弹性各向同性模型，且从未对实物踝件加载过。站立工况通过，安全系数 2.0210。
branches_en: a stronger material fixes it
we adopt it for that part only and re-cost the BOM
orientation fixes it
we fix the orientation on the drawing and in the slicer profile so it cannot be lost
you think the case is unrealistic
say what you would use instead and we re-run — this is exactly the kind of judgement we do not have without a factory
it needs a redesign
we redesign the ankle; it is one of the 8 parts that are ours outright, so there is no licence obstacle
branches_zh: 更强材料即可解决
我方仅对该零件采用该材料并重算 BOM 成本
改变打印方向即可解决
我方将该方向固化到图纸与切片配置中，防止丢失
贵方认为该工况不合理
请给出贵方建议的工况，我方重跑——这正是没有工厂就无法获得的判断
需要重新设计
我方重新设计踝件；它属于我方完全自有的 8 个零件之一，无许可障碍

questions.ours_en: CORRECTION, and it changes this question. Until 2026-09-04 this pack said Pollen's board is 65.0 x 48.5 mm and that adopting it means re-modelling the motor support. That figure was wrong. Measured tonight off the Edge.Cuts layer of Pollen's own kicad_pcb (commit 23eab119), the board is 65.0000 × 30.9001 mm. The 48.5 was the bounding box of the file's Dwgs.User ANNOTATION layer, whose dimension witness lines hang 17.7 mm below the copper. So the real difference from our own 65.0 × 30.0 mm reconstruction is 0.9001 mm on one axis, and from the simulation mesh the Microduck actually carries (65.025 × 30.025 mm) it is 0.8751 mm. Apache-2.0 permits manufacture, modification and SALE, and Pollen's package includes Gerbers, BOM, POS and a STEP model. Adopting it is therefore a CLEARANCE CHECK, not a re-model — and it is the single move that both shortens our critical path and cleans the licence position. ONE THING IS STILL OPEN: nobody has measured the HAT pocket in our motor-support part against a 65.0000 × 30.9001 mm board. That is parcel B-3a, half an engineer-day of desk work, and it is running.
questions.ours_zh: 更正，且这会改变本问题。直至 2026-09-04，本交付包一直称 Pollen 的板为 65.0 x 48.5 mm，并称采用它需重做电机支架。该数据是错的。今夜从 Pollen 自己的 kicad_pcb（提交 23eab119）的 Edge.Cuts 层实测，该板为 65.0000 × 30.9001 mm。48.5 是该文件 Dwgs.User 标注层的包络框，其尺寸引出线延伸到铜层下方 17.7 mm。因此与我方 65.0 × 30.0 mm 重构版的真实差异只有一个轴上的 0.9001 mm；与 Microduck 实际所载的仿真网格（65.025 × 30.025 mm）相差 0.8751 mm。Apache-2.0 允许制造、修改与销售，且 Pollen 的资料包含 Gerber、BOM、坐标文件与 STEP 模型。因此采用它是一次间隙核对，不是重做——而且这是唯一一步既能缩短我方关键路径、又能理顺许可关系的动作。仍有一项未定：无人测量过我方电机支架上的 HAT 板槽能否容纳 65.0000 × 30.9001 mm 的板。那是工作包 B-3a，半个人天的案头工作，目前正在进行。
